rules.rule: General PR (F-5-1) requires 기본소양 (basic knowledge) as a hard condition. Accepted proofs: a KIIP completion certificate on the PR track (한국이민영주적격과정, i.e. level 5 기본, 70h) or the naturalization track, or a pass certificate for the comprehensive test (KIPRAT for PR or KINAT for naturalization, 60/100). TOPIK has not counted since 2019-04-01; TOPIK 4-6 was accepted only for applications filed by 2019-03-31. One exception: an E-5 holder doing a residency in a Korean hospital may use TOPIK 5+.
rules.amount: KIIP level 5 completion, or comprehensive test 60+
rules.conditions: Waived for applicants the manual treats as exempt (not defined in visadocs). Must be valid on the application date.
rules.stacks: KIIP 5 also scores bonus points under F-2-7; for F-5-1 it does not lower income (the 70% cut is F-5-6 only)
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-1.change (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 체류자격 변경허가 › 공통 서류 + 1. 일반 영주자〔F-5-1〕 › 다. 제출서류)
rules.quote: 기본소양 요건 입증서류 — 'Not for exempt applicants. Submit at least one: KIPRAT pass certificate (PR comprehensive test); KINAT pass certificate (naturalization test); KIIP completion certificate, PR track; KIIP completion certificate, naturalization track; TOPIK level 4-6 score report (only for applications filed by 2019-03-31)... F-5-1 applicants on E-5 doing a residency in a Korean hospital: TOPIK level 5+ counts as basic knowledge.'

rules.rule: Degree or licence PR (F-5-10) uses the same basic-knowledge proof as F-5-1: KIIP PR or naturalization track completed, or KIPRAT/KINAT pass. TOPIK is not accepted. No minor or degree exemption is listed.
rules.amount: KIIP level 5 completion, or comprehensive test 60+
rules.conditions: none beyond the general exempt-applicant clause
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-10.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 7. 학사․석사 학위증 및 자격증 소지자〔F-5-10〕)
rules.quote: 기본소양 요건 입증서류 — 'Not for exempt applicants. Submit at least one: KIPRAT pass certificate...; KINAT pass certificate...; KIIP completion certificate, PR track; KIIP completion certificate, naturalization track'

rules.rule: Points-based PR (F-5-16) has the same hard basic-knowledge requirement: KIIP completion (PR or naturalization track) or KIPRAT/KINAT pass. TOPIK is not accepted.
rules.amount: KIIP level 5 completion, or comprehensive test 60+
rules.conditions: none listed
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-16.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 11. 점수제 영주자〔F-5-16〕 및 그 배우자와 미성년 자녀〔F-5-18〕)
rules.quote: 기본소양 요건 입증서류 — 'Not for exempt applicants. Submit at least one: KIPRAT...; KINAT...; KIIP completion certificate, PR track; KIIP completion certificate, naturalization track'

rules.rule: Special-contributor PR (F-5-28) needs the common basic-knowledge proof: KIIP completion or KIPRAT/KINAT pass.
rules.amount: KIIP level 5 completion, or comprehensive test 60+
rules.conditions: The F-5-28 section lists no documents of its own; only the common list applies.

rules.rule: For the spouse or minor child of a general PR holder (F-5-4), the same basic-knowledge proof is required (KIIP completion or KIPRAT/KINAT). Minors under 15, and minors 15+ in regular schooling, are exempt.
rules.amount: KIIP level 5 completion, or comprehensive test 60+
rules.conditions: Exempt: under 15, or 15+ and enrolled in regular education
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-4.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 3. 일반 영주자의 배우자 또는 미성년 자녀〔F-5-4〕)
rules.quote: '...Must be within its validity period on the application date. Exempt: minors under 15, and minors 15+ enrolled in regular education.'

rules.rule: Family of a points-based PR holder (F-5-18): the same KIIP completion or KIPRAT/KINAT requirement applies. Minors under 15, and minors 15+ in regular schooling, are exempt.
rules.amount: KIIP level 5 completion, or comprehensive test 60+
rules.conditions: Exempt: under 15, or 15+ in regular education

rules.rule: For the spouse or minor child of a special contributor (F-5-29), the manual's list includes the basic-knowledge proof (KIIP completion or KIPRAT/KINAT), with the same minor exemption. The current data has no lang entry for F-5-29.
rules.amount: KIIP level 5 completion, or comprehensive test 60+
rules.conditions: Exempt: under 15, or 15+ in regular education

rules.quote: 기본소양 요건 입증서류 — '...Exempt: minors under 15, and minors 15+ enrolled in regular education.'

rules.rule: K-STAR family PR (F-5-S2) follows the F-5-18 guideline, so it needs KIIP completion or KIPRAT/KINAT, with the same minor exemption. The current data has no lang entry for F-5-S2.
rules.amount: KIIP level 5 completion, or comprehensive test 60+
rules.conditions: Exempt: under 15, or 15+ in regular education

rules.quote: 기본소양 요건 입증서류 — '...Exempt: minors under 15, and minors 15+ enrolled in regular education.'

rules.rule: Marriage-migrant PR (F-5-2) requires basic knowledge in all three cases (married to a Korean, raising a Korean child, marriage ended not by your fault). Two routes count: KIIP completed (PR or naturalization track certificate), or a comprehensive-test score of 60+ (KIPRAT or KINAT pass certificate). TOPIK is not accepted.
rules.conditions: Unverified lead: applicants aged 60+, or caring for a seriously ill spouse or child, are exempt (see open questions)
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-2.change v0-v2 (manual 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 2. 결혼이민자(F-5-2), 국민의 미성년 자녀(F-5-3) › 가.~다. › 2) 제출 서류)
rules.quote: “사회통합프로그램 이수증”(한국이민영주적격과정 또는 한국이민귀화적격과정) (사회통합프로그램 이수) / “한국이민영주적격시험 합격증”(KIPRAT) 또는 “한국이민귀화적격시험 합격증”(KINAT) (종합평가 60점 이상)

rules.rule: For the minor child of a Korean citizen (F-5-3), the manual lists the same two basic-knowledge routes as F-5-2: KIIP completed, or comprehensive test 60+. A third route, regular Korean schooling, works as an exemption: a graduation certificate, a 검정고시 pass or a school enrolment certificate. The current data has no lang entry for F-5-3.
rules.amount: KIIP completion or comprehensive test 60+; or regular Korean schooling
rules.conditions: Exempt route: a child who completed, or is attending, regular Korean education (graduation certificate, 검정고시 pass or enrolment certificate)
rules.effect: blocks unless one route is met
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-3.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 2. 결혼이민자(F-5-2), 국민의 미성년 자녀(F-5-3) › 라. › 2) 제출 서류)
rules.quote: (사회통합프로그램 이수) 사회통합프로그램 이수증 / (종합평가 60점 이상) KIPRAT 또는 KINAT 합격증 / (정규교육 과정 이수자) 졸업증명서, 검정고시 합격증, 재학증명서 등

rules.rule: Ethnic-Korean PR via meeting the nationality requirements (F-5-7): a KIIP PR-track completion certificate or a KIPRAT pass certificate is required for the general and simplified-naturalization cases. It is not required for nationality-restoration or special-naturalization cases. The current data has no lang entry for F-5-7.
rules.amount: KIIP level 5 (PR track) completion, or KIPRAT pass
rules.conditions: Not required for nationality restoration (art. 9) or special-naturalization cases
rules.effect: blocks: hard requirement for the general and simplified cases
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-7.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 36. 외국국적동포 관련 › 5. 외국국적동포 영주자격(F-5) 부여 세부절차 › 나. › 국적취득요건을 갖춘 사람(F-5-7))
rules.quote: 사회통합프로그램 한국이민영주적격과정이수증 또는 한국이민영주적격시험 합격증 — note: 'Not required for nationality-restoration or special-naturalization cases.'

rules.rule: Overseas-Korean PR (F-5-6) has no KIIP or language requirement: none of its six case lists contains a basic-knowledge document. Since 2026-02-12, a 한국어 우수자 needs only 70% of GNI income instead of 100%, and 60% if also a 우수 자원봉사자. A 한국어 우수자 is someone who has completed KIIP level 5, graduated from all of Korean elementary, middle and high school, or holds a Korean bachelor's degree or higher.
rules.amount: KIIP level 5 (or all Korean schooling, or a Korean bachelor's+) cuts income to 0.7× GNI; 0.6× with volunteering
rules.conditions: F-4 held for 2+ years
rules.effect: reduces the income requirement; never blocks
rules.stacks: Stacks with the volunteering cut to 0.6× (the floor)
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-6.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 36. › 5.); 2026-02-12 MOJ 동포 integration notice as quoted in round2/research_R3.json rules[11]
rules.quote: '한국어 우수자' 전년도 GNI의 70% 이상 충족 시 동포 영주자격(F-5) 소득요건 인정 (한국어 우수자: 사회통합프로그램 5단계 이수, 국내 초·중·고교를 모두 졸업한 자, 국내 학사 이상 학위 취득자)

rules.rule: The basic-knowledge (KIIP) requirement does not apply to F-5-5 (large investor), F-5-9 (high-tech doctorate), F-5-15 (Korean doctorate), F-5-11 (outstanding ability) or F-5-12 (special merit). The manual's document lists for F-5-5, F-5-9, F-5-11 and F-5-15 contain no basic-knowledge document.
rules.conditions: none

rules.rule: These codes have no basic-knowledge document in the 2026.9.18 manual's lists: F-5-13 (pensioner), F-5-17, F-5-19, F-5-21, F-5-22, F-5-24, F-5-25, F-5-26 and F-5-T1. So there is no KIIP or TOPIK requirement for them.
rules.conditions: none

rules.rule: Top-Tier PR (F-5-T) requires KIIP level 3+ or TOPIK level 3+. This is a hard requirement for both the industry-ministry and science-ministry tracks.
rules.conditions: none listed

rules.quote: 한국어능력 입증서류 — 'KIIP level 3+ or TOPIK level 3+.'

rules.rule: In K-STAR PR (F-5-S1), Korean ability is one of the scored items (labelled 기본소양) in the 90/200 K-STAR points test, proven by a TOPIK score report or KIIP completion. No separate minimum is listed, so it appears to be points only, not a hard requirement.
rules.conditions: none
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-S1.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 41. K-STAR 비자트랙 › Ⅲ. K-STAR 영주(F-5-S1) › 4. 제출서류 (+ 붙임 7))
rules.quote: 한국어능력시험(TOPIK) 성적표 또는 사회통합프로그램 이수증 (onlyKo: 기본소양; 'For the Korean-language item'; 'The KIIP certificate need not be submitted (checked in the KIIP system).')

rules.rule: Long-term resident (F-2-99) needs basic knowledge of Korean language and culture, a hard requirement. Accepted: KIIP level 4 completed; KIIP pre-test 81+; graduation from a Korean elementary, middle or high school; graduation from a Korean university, graduate school or polytechnic; or a 검정고시 pass. TOPIK is not on the list. Exempt: proof at KIIP-4 level already on file, Korea-born Taiwanese Chinese, and former Korean nationals.
rules.amount: KIIP 4 (or pre-test 81+), or Korean school or degree
rules.conditions: Exempt: earlier KIIP-4-level proof on file; Korea-born Taiwanese Chinese; former Korean nationals
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-99.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 30. 거주(F-2) › 체류자격 변경허가 › 9. 기타 장기체류자 › □ 체류자격 변경 심사)
rules.quote: 한국어와 한국문화에 대한 기본소양 입증서류 — 'One of: KIIP level 4 completed; KIIP pre-test 81+; Korean elementary/middle/high school graduation; Korean university/graduate school/polytechnic graduation; Korean qualification exam pass. Exempt: earlier proof at KIIP-4 level already on file; Korea-born Taiwanese Chinese; former Korean nationals'

rules.rule: Regional talent (F-2-R) requires, valid on the application date, KIIP level 3 completion (or a pre-test placement at level 4+) or TOPIK 3+. This has applied since 2026-08-03 under 법무부고시 제2026-248호 제4조제1항. From 2025-02-20 to 2026-08-02 the bar was KIIP 4 / TOPIK 4; before that it was level 3. So level 3 is correct in October 2026.
rules.conditions: Valid on the application date
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-R.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 37. 지역특화형비자 › Ⅱ. 지역특화형 우수인재(F-2) › (1) 체류자격 변경 › 4. 제출서류); 법무부고시 제2026-248호 제4조제1항 (per round2/verify_d2_9.json); jobploy.kr 2026 regional-visa summary (lead)
rules.quote: visadocs: 'At least one, valid on the application date: KIIP level-3 completion or pre-test placement at level 4+; TOPIK level 3+ score report'; jobploy: '2026년 8월 3일부터 한국어 요건이 완화됩니다 ... TOPIK 3급 이상, 사회통합프로그램 3단계 이상 이수, 또는 사전평가 4단계 이상 배정'

rules.rule: Points-based residence (F-2-7) has no Korean minimum. Korean is a scored item (기본소양, max 20 points): TOPIK or KIIP level 1 = 3, level 2 = 5, level 3 = 10, level 4 = 15, level 5+ = 20. Completing KIIP level 5+ also earns a 10-point bonus. The pass mark is 80 points.
rules.conditions: none
rules.stacks: The KIIP 5 bonus counts within the 40-point bonus cap
rules.source: F-2-7 민원인 제출용 점수표 (법무부고시 제2025-408호 table; scratchpad research/f27table); data/visadocs.yaml F-2-7.change points-proof note
rules.quote: ○ 기본소양 (최대 20점) 한국어 능력 TOPIK 5급 이상/사회통합프로그램 5단계 20 · 4급/4단계 15 · 3급/3단계 10 · 2급/2단계 5 · 1급/1단계 3; 가점항목: 사회통합프로그램 5단계이상 10

rules.rule: The special route from E-7-S1 or E-7-S2 to F-2-7 after 1+ year replaces the 80-point test. Instead, E-7-S1 holders must keep the income level and E-7-S2 holders must keep 60+ points, and both must complete KIIP level 3+.
rules.conditions: 1+ year on E-7-S
rules.source: immikorea.com E-7-S guide (practitioner, quoted in visa-map-audit/findings.md); not confirmed in an MOJ text by this round's searches
rules.quote: '국내에 1년 이상 네거티브 방식의 전문인력 자격으로 체류하면서 E-7-S1은 소득요건이 유지되고 E-7-S2는 점수요건 60점 이상을 충족하고 사회통합프로그램 3단계 이상 이수'

rules.rule: No Korean requirement was found for F-2-T, F-2-T1, F-2-7S, F-2-71, F-2-2, F-2-3, F-2-4, F-2-5, F-2-8, F-2-81, F-2-12, F-2-13 or F-2-16: none of their manual lists has a basic-knowledge document. The F-2-7S and F-2-71 lists repeat the F-2-7 points-proof document only because the list is shared.
rules.conditions: none
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml change/abroad lists for these codes (manual 2026.9.18 › 30. 거주(F-2), 39. 톱티어, 41. K-STAR)
rules.quote: (no 기본소양 / 사회통합프로그램 / TOPIK document in these lists)

rules.rule: Spouse of a Korean (F-6-1) must meet a communication requirement, from abroad or in Korea. Option 1, the foreign spouse has basic Korean, shown by any one of: TOPIK 1+ (IBT accepted); a Korean Education Centre level-2 or King Sejong Institute beginner 1A+1B certificate (120+ hours); a certificate from a designated Korean-language institution (only where the country has one); or a Korean-related university or graduate degree. Option 2, the couple shares a language, shown by any one of: the foreign spouse is an ethnic Korean; the foreign spouse stayed in Korea 1+ continuous year; the Korean spouse lived 1+ year in a country where the foreign spouse's language is official, or is a naturalized citizen from such a country; both lived 1+ year in a country where a third shared language is official; or other proof (a language-test score at a set level, or an embassy interview). KIIP is not on the manual's list.
rules.conditions: Not needed (no language documents in the simplified lists) when the couple has a child together, or when the foreign spouse held F-6 before with the same uninterrupted marriage
rules.effect: blocks unless an alternative or an exemption applies
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-6-1.change v0/v1/v3 and F-6-1.abroad (manual 2026.9.18 › 33. 결혼이민(F-6) › 1. 국민의 배우자(F-6-1) › 라. 제출서류; 사증발급 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 34.); v2 (child) and v4 (prior F-6) lists contain no language document
rules.quote: 한국어능력시험(TOPIK) 성적증명서 ('TOPIK level 1 or higher (TOPIK IBT accepted)'); 한국교육원(한국어강좌 2단계) 수료증, 세종학당(초급1A+1B) 수료증 ('120+ hours'); 지정된 한국어 교육기관 이수증; 한국어 관련 대학(원) 학위증; 외국국적동포 입증서류; 외국인 배우자가 한국에서 1년 이상 계속 체류 입증서류; 그 밖의 의사소통 가능 입증서류

rules.rule: Skilled worker (E-7-4) requires minimum Korean ability: TOPIK 2+, KIIP level 2 completion, or a KIIP pre-test score of 41+. Korean is also one of the five scored items in the 300-point test (pass at 200 including bonus). Proof: a TOPIK score report; KIIP completion or pre-test results need no paper. Unverified lead: a temporary grace period runs until 2026-12-31, allowing the level to be reached within 2 years of approval for applicants with 50+ income points and 150+ points excluding language.
rules.conditions: 4+ years on E-9, E-10 or H-2 within 10 years; grace period unverified
rules.source: pigpeople.net news on the agriculture E-7-4 quota (ministry-related; lead); MOJ document moj.go.kr/bbs/immigration/214/495389 (points structure); data/visadocs.yaml E-7-4.change (manual 2026.9.18 › 25. › 숙련기능인력(E-7-4) › 붙임2); seoulstart.com (grace-period lead)

rules.rule: KIIP in 2026: KIIP completion for PR means the 영주적격과정 (level 5 basic, 70 hours); naturalization is 100 hours. The comprehensive-test pass mark is 60/100. In July 2026 the MOJ announced only a reform direction (mandatory KIIP, courses tailored to stay type, pre-departure education). Nothing was found in force that changes the 2026 levels above.
rules.conditions: none
rules.source: MOJ KIIP page (immigration.go.kr/moj/369/subview.do); MOJ press release '법무부, 사회통합프로그램 개편방향 마련… 운영기관 대표자 현장의견 수렴' (immigration.go.kr/bbs/immigration/214/608406/artclView.do)

notes:
I used all 16 WebSearch calls. Every result came back as a summarised extract; no official page could be opened. So most established rules rest on data/visadocs.yaml, the transcription of the 2026.9.18 and 2026.9.1 KIS manuals, plus the F-2-7 points table already in the scratchpad.

Codes that differ from the data:
- Missing lang hints where the manual requires KIIP completion or the comprehensive test (60+): F-5-3, F-5-7, F-5-29 and F-5-S2. F-5-29 and F-5-S2 exempt minors under 15, and minors 15+ in regular schooling. F-5-3 also accepts regular Korean schooling.
- Unsourced: F-5-6R's {kiip: 5}.
- Not supported by the manual: F-6-1's kiip: 2.

Codes that match the data:
- F-5-1, F-5-2, F-5-4, F-5-10, F-5-16, F-5-18, F-5-28: KIIP 5 or the comprehensive test (60+), a hard requirement; TOPIK has not counted since 2019-04-01.
- F-2-99: KIIP 4, or pre-test 81+, or a Korean school or degree; TOPIK does not count.
- F-2-R: KIIP 3 (or pre-test level 4+) or TOPIK 3, in force since 2026-08-03; it was level 4 from 2025-02-20 to 2026-08-02. The level-4 findings in visa-map-audit/findings.md are out of date.
- F-5-T: KIIP 3 or TOPIK 3.
- E-7-4: TOPIK 2, KIIP 2 or pre-test 41+, a minimum plus a points item.
- E-7-S -> F-2-7: KIIP 3 (practitioner source only).

Codes with no language requirement:
- F-5-6: none, though KIIP 5 lowers the income bar to 70% of GNI.
- F-5-5, F-5-9, F-5-11, F-5-15 and F-5-12: exempt, named in the MOJ 동포 guide.
- F-5-13, F-5-17, F-5-19, F-5-21, F-5-22, F-5-24, F-5-25, F-5-26 and F-5-T1: no basic-knowledge document in the manual lists.
- F-2-7: points only (Korean scores 3 to 20, plus a 10-point KIIP 5 bonus).
- F-2-T, F-2-T1, F-2-7S, F-2-71, F-2-2, F-2-3, F-2-4, F-2-5, F-2-8, F-2-81, F-2-12, F-2-13 and F-2-16: none.

The lang field holds only {topik, kiip}. It cannot express the comprehensive-test alternative, school or degree exemptions, or minor or age exemptions, so those belong in the how texts.
